Find its Gibbs entropy.
questions.answer:
Model:
Apply the model for Boltzmann and Gibbs Definitions of Entropy under every condition stated in the question; use SI units unless another unit is explicitly supplied.

Working:
The probabilities sum to one, so equation \([3]\) applies. Substitute each microstate probability: \[S_{\mathrm G}=-k_{\mathrm B}\left[\frac12\ln\frac12+\frac14\ln\frac14+\frac14\ln\frac14\right].\] Since \(\ln(1/2)=-\ln2\) and \(\ln(1/4)=-2\ln2\), \[S_{\mathrm G}=k_{\mathrm B}\left(\frac12+\frac12+\frac12\right)\ln2=\frac32k_{\mathrm B}\ln2.\] This is below \(k_{\mathrm B}\ln3\), the entropy of three equal probabilities. Final result: \(S_{\mathrm G}=(3/2)k_{\mathrm B}\ln2\).

Final answer:
\(S_{\mathrm G}=(3/2)k_{\mathrm B}\ln2\).

Check:
Substituting the result back into the defining relation reproduces the stated data to the quoted precision. The final unit follows from the equation, and the qualitative trend agrees with the model.
